How we work

A website design and development process you can actually follow.

No black box, no ghosting. You get a named project lead, a shared timeline, and a deliverable at the end of every stage — so you always know what's happening and what's next.

Step 01 / 06
Book a 20-minute scoping call
  1. 01

    Discovery & buyer mapping

    We interview you and your sales team, study competitors, and map what a buyer needs to see before they enquire.

    Sitemap + messaging brief
  2. 02

    Wireframes & content strategy

    Structure before styling. Every section earns its place, and the copy is written for the decision, not the word count.

    Low-fi wireframes + copy deck
  3. 03

    Design system & UI

    Type scale, colour, components and motion — designed desktop and mobile side by side so nothing breaks on a phone.

    Figma design system
  4. 04

    Development & integrations

    Clean, componentised builds on Shopify, WordPress or React — with CRM, payments, WhatsApp and analytics wired in.

    Staging build + QA sheet
  5. 05

    Speed, SEO & QA

    Core Web Vitals, schema, redirects, cross-browser and real-device testing before anything goes near production.

    Launch readiness report
  6. 06

    Launch & optimisation

    We ship, watch the data, and keep improving — heatmaps, form drop-off and A/B tests on the pages that matter.

    Monthly performance review
